retrievalProfile.description: A tight, high-contrast male portrait featuring a cowboy hat with dramatic side-lighting and bold, metallic-effect block typography anchored at the bottom.
triggerTerms: cowboy hat close-up with dramatic shadows
metallic block lettering on dark background
excludeWhen: bright, airy, or high-key lighting is requested
minimalist or serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic close-up of a man in a cowboy hat, utilizing heavy shadows to define facial structure, paired with a heavy, wide-set sans-serif title featuring a gold-to-silver gradient and thick outlines.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the hat creates a diagonal shadow across the upper face.
The warm skin tones contrast with the cool, dark clothing.
The horizontal weight of the typography balances the verticality of the face.
coreInvariants: Tight cropping that cuts off the top of the hat
Strong directional key light from the side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and fills 80% of the frame vertically, cropped from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one in the light, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, then drop to the heavy block text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, mostly concentrated in the dark shadows of the clothing and background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and cream tones in the skin and hat.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and bronze gradients in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast (deep blacks vs. bright highlights).

letterConstructionRules: Square proportions with rounded outer corners
Small counters relative to stroke width
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a descender that hooks sharply

treatment.outline: thick black stroke with outer white glow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide, lowercase display font paired with a smaller, monospaced or technical sans-serif for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square geometric structure.
Provides the necessary masculine, industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with a goatee wearing a light-colored cowboy hat. Use dramatic side-lighting to create deep shadows on one side of the face. The background should be dark and textured.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a wide, bold lowercase sans-serif title across the bottom. Use a metallic gold gradient fill and a thick black outline. Add a smaller line of white sans-serif text directly below it.

verificationChecks: Is the hat brim casting a distinct shadow?
Is the main text extra-wide and lowercase?
Does the text have a metallic gradient effect?
Is the crop tight on the face?

adjustableVariables: Color of the metallic gradient (silver vs gold)
Amount of facial hair on the subject
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song title
Exact facial features of the specific individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark clothing.
Check that the hat does not look digitally pasted on.
Verify the gradient direction in the text is consistent.
Confirm the eyes are sharp and in focus.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rugged Male Subject + Cowboy Hat + Side-Lighting + Wide Metallic Typography = Modern Country Aesthetic
